title: Anderson Acceleration for Distributed Constrained Optimization over Time-varying Networks
summary: This paper applies the Anderson Acceleration (AA) technique to accelerate the Fenchel dual gradient method (FDGM) to solve constrained optimization problems over time-varying networks. AA is originally designed for accelerating fixed-point iterations, and its direct application to FDGM faces two challenges: 1) FDGM in time-varying networks cannot be formulated as a standard fixed-point update; 2) even if the network is fixed so that FDGM can be expressed as a fixed-point iteration, the direct application of AA is not distributively implementable.
